# docker_plugins (Data Source)

Lists the managed plugins installed on the provider's Docker host (`GET /plugins`), like `docker plugin ls`. The list is sorted by name; the raw `plugins_json` output is sensitive because plugin settings can hold credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Enabled volume driver plugins.
data "docker_plugins" "volume_drivers" {
  capability = "volumedriver"
  enabled    = true
}

output "volume_driver_plugins" {
  value = data.docker_plugins.volume_drivers.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `capability` (String) Only plugins with this capability (Engine `capability` filter), e.g. `volumedriver` or `networkdriver`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) `true` lists only enabled plugins, `false` only disabled ones.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of plugins_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the listed plugins, in the order of `plugins`.
- `names` (List of String) Names of the listed plugins (e.g. `vieux/sshfs:latest`), in the order of `plugins`.
- `plugins` (Attributes List) The GET /plugins response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins))
- `plugins_json` (String, Sensitive) The exact Engine API GET /plugins response as JSON.
